dialogue.speaker: Zarina
dialogue.text: Aizhan, your alarm rings so early! What time is it? 6:30?!

dialogue.speaker: Aizhan
dialogue.text: Yes! I get up at 6:30 every day. Early mornings are the best!

dialogue.speaker: Zarina
dialogue.text: For you, maybe! I get up at 7:15. I press snooze at least twice.

dialogue.speaker: Aizhan
dialogue.text: Ha! I never press snooze. I get up immediately — it is my habit.

dialogue.speaker: Zarina
dialogue.text: Amazing. What do you do first? Go to the cafeteria?

dialogue.speaker: Aizhan
dialogue.text: No, first I stretch for five minutes and wash my face. Then breakfast.

dialogue.speaker: Zarina
dialogue.text: I do yoga every morning — ten minutes. It gives me energy!

dialogue.speaker: Aizhan
dialogue.text: That's great! Do you eat breakfast after yoga?

dialogue.speaker: Zarina
dialogue.text: Sometimes I skip breakfast. I just grab a banana and run to class.

dialogue.speaker: Aizhan
dialogue.text: Skip breakfast? That's terrible! I always eat porridge or an omelette.

dialogue.speaker: Zarina
dialogue.text: I know, I know. But I'm always in a rush. I'm not a morning person!

dialogue.speaker: Aizhan
dialogue.text: I listen to English podcasts on my walk to class. It helps me wake up!

dialogue.speaker: Zarina
dialogue.text: Podcasts? In the morning? I am half asleep at that time!

dialogue.speaker: Aizhan
dialogue.text: Try it! What time do you feel most energetic? Morning or afternoon?

dialogue.speaker: Zarina
dialogue.text: Definitely afternoon. After lunch I feel amazing. Mornings are exhausting!

dialogue.speaker: Aizhan
dialogue.text: We are so different! But that's why we are good roommates, I think!
